record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.scope: The two units in appliesTo declare PECK (passive NONE). Shared strategy; they differ by stars and stats. DRILL_PECK is a different ability and is not covered.
record.summary: Single-target SPECIAL damage, 10 / 30 / 50 / 100 raw by the caster's stars (fallback 100), no other effect. The requested amount is the table value; AP scaling (x(1 + AP/100)) and the crit multiplier (only if the cast crit) are applied inside handleSpecialDamage; the target's SPE_DEF division follows, so the applied HP loss is lower. The returned takenDamage is ignored by PECK.

targeting.who: the cast target passed to the strategy (the caster's current target)
targeting.note: requiresTarget is the base default true; how the target is chosen before the cast was not read here.

effects.scaling: AP: damage x (1 + AP/100) (apBoost defaults to true, so the caster's ap is applied); the cast crit flag multiplies by critPower (reduced by the target's critReductionFactor) only if the cast crit (canCritByDefault is false)
effects.resolution: intermediate, not guaranteed final HP damage: handleSpecialDamage first returns takenDamage 0 (spellBlockedCount++) if the target is protected, skydiving or magicBounce; otherwise handleDamage divides by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF) (ceil, min 1) among other steps. The returned takenDamage is the shield-absorbed part plus the HP lost (capped at current HP), rounded; 0 for a dead/resurrecting target; the Shiny Charm branch resets it to 0 (and death to false); the Fossil branch adds to it; a Cover Band redirect returns the cover ally's result. See core-mechanics.md §A and the BITE record for the shared takenDamage breakdown (probe: assistant/probes/pinned-helper-probe.mjs).

starBehavior.note: Indexed by the casting entity's stars; 3 stars (50) and 4 stars (100, also the fallback) are not reachable by these two units' bare star counts. maxPP is 100 and range 1 for both.

record.positionalConditions: None read beyond needing a target (the unit must be in range of it to cast, since requiresTarget is true).
record.repeatedCastsAndModes: No stored state, no modes. Each cast repeats the same damage call.
record.rawVsResolved: Requested: 10 (Spearow) / 30 (Fearow) raw. Applied: raw x (1 + AP/100) [x crit factor if crit], then SPE_DEF division (ceil, at least 1) and the other handleDamage steps (shield absorption, Shiny Charm, Fossil, Cover Band); the reported takenDamage (shield part + HP part) is not used by PECK. Blocked entirely (0) by protect / skydiving / magicBounce.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Final damage after handleDamage's later modifiers (items, damage-reduction effects, resurrection, field multipliers); the SPE_DEF division, shield/HP accounting and the Shiny Charm, Fossil and Cover Band branches were read (shared with the BITE record)
When the cast fires in a real fight (PP gain, targeting before the cast, silence): only the pp >= maxPP && canCast gate was read
Crit resolution: only the canCritByDefault gate and the damage-side multiplier were read
unresolved: Whether any item, synergy or passive on the caster or target changes PECK beyond what is listed (the Power Lens retaliation inside handleSpecialDamage was seen but not traced for PECK)
No other unit declares PECK in the queue record; DRILL_PECK (a separate ability) is not covered
Behaviour in a real fight is unobserved: this is source reading plus mechanical checks
